Item Sets v1.0 (MHFU ULJM05500, FUComplete v1.4.0) - port of Kurogami2134's MHP3rd item sets

Item box, main menu (Put In Item / Take Out Item / ...):
  L / R            load item set 1 / 2: your pouch goes back into the box, then the set's
                   items are taken out of the box (as many as the box has)
  Select + L / R   save your current pouch as item set 1 / 2
Sounds: save = menu open, load = confirm, empty set = error.
Nothing is lost: an item that doesn't fit back into a full box stays in the pouch.
Sets are saved in PSP/SAVEDATA/MHFU_ITEM_SETS.BIN (shared by all characters).
Memory: 0x09FFA080-0x09FFA59F (code and data). Source: bonus/item_sets.asm
